t: What Species Interaction Database Is All About
title: What Species Interaction Database Is All About
description: Species interact in webs: wolves reshape rivers (trophic cascades in Yellowstone), bees pollinate a third of crops, and clownfish trade protection for cleaning with anemones. Remove a keystone species and the web rewires — sea otters eat urchins, protecting kelp forests. Every interaction here names the partners, the mechanism, and the evidence. This database is the complete species interaction: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Species Interaction Database: a complete reference database of full species interaction records.
key_points: What this database holds: full species interaction records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.
Scope: Species interact in webs: wolves reshape rivers (trophic cascades in Yellowstone), bees pollinate a third of crops, and clownfish trade protection for cleaning with anemones.
Every record is the full entry — never a stub or description alone.
Teaching ladder: Foundations first, then Compounded, then Advanced.

description: Every field has its own language. predation: one eats the other
parasitism: one benefits, host harmed
keystone species: outsized ecological role

symbiosis: long-term interspecies living together
